name: hormozi_punch
description: The Hormozi look: bold one-word-pop captions with keyword color emphasis, aggressive punch-ins, hard cuts only, and a pop SFX on the caption beat. Built for maximum retention on value/teaching content.

grade.notes: neutral_punch = +6% contrast + a subtle S-curve, no color shift. Clean and punchy without going cinematic — the words are the star, the picture just needs to read crisp.

captions.notes: Giant bold single words, pop-in, with keywords and every number in the accent color. This caption style IS the format — it carries the whole retention mechanic.

punch_in.notes: Aggressive 16% punch landing in 2 frames on nearly every cut — a hard snap that keeps the eye moving.

pacing.notes: Fast, relentless hard cuts. Remove every dead beat. Cut on the punctuation of speech.

transition.notes: HARD CUTS ONLY. The Hormozi style is defined by its complete absence of fancy transitions — the cut itself is the rhythm.

sfx.notes: A tight pop on the keyword caption beats. No risers or whooshes — those belong to the sizzle look, not this one.

notes: The value/teaching retention format. Distinct from dark_sizzle: same one-word captions, but NO transitions (hard cuts only) and a cleaner neutral_punch grade instead of a cinematic one. The energy comes from caption pace + punch-in + pops, not from dissolves or color.
